instance.description: Returns the forwarding table (FIB) entries of the converged data plane.
instance.longDescription: Lists, for each node and VRF, every FIB entry: the main-RIB route it comes from and the forwarding action (forward out an interface to an ARP IP, discard, or look up in another VRF).

nodes.description: Examine FIBs on nodes matching this specifier

vrfs.description: Examine FIBs of VRFs matching this name or regex
